user_request: Explore lower-latency, more natural teleoperation through forecasting, shorter previews, smoothing and causal alternatives.

actual_training_checkpoint_config.important_branch: sample_human_masks returns full GOAL_K immediately for mode full. preview_mix only changes the mixed branch; short horizons were not thereby trained.
actual_training_checkpoint_config.native_mask_capability: 1..10 prefix frames; normalized pose and heading rows both masked.

limits: Three existing retargeted upper-body reference trajectories only; eight scalar angle channels.
No human SE(3), root, contact, policy, simulation or real-robot evaluation.
No model selection or tuning on these results; noise is synthetic iid Gaussian.
Origin t and buffer b expose through t+b only; no samples after that enter prediction.
Fixed buffer time excludes capture, transport, filter, policy and actuator latency.
Compute timings are local Python operations on eight scalars, not GPU policy latency.

covers: Exact constant-velocity extrapolation and preserved observations
Prediction invariant to samples after the declared cutoff
Reject invalid visible prefix and buffer
